section.catchline: Disposition of taxes collected -- Credit to General Fund -- Transfer to State Reinvestment Restricted Account.
section.subsection: Except as provided in Section 51-9-305, 51-9-306, or 51-9-1102, or Subsection 59-5-202(5), a tax imposed and collected under Section 59-5-202 shall be paid to the commission, promptly remitted to the state treasurer, and credited to the General Fund.

For a fiscal year beginning on or after July 1, 2026, the Division of Finance shall transfer from the General Fund to the State Reinvestment Restricted Account created in Section 51-9-1102 the amount credited to the General Fund under Subsection (1) that exceeds $11,526,000.
